1.w: [“] But, please, O Job, hear my speech, and give ear [to] all my words.

2.w: Behold now, I open my mouth; my tongue speaks in my palate.

3.w: From the straightness of my heart [are] my words, and my lips, being pure, speak knowledge.

4.w: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of Shaddai gives me life.

5.w: If you are able to refute me, arrange it before my face; station yourself.

6.w: Behold, I [am] according to your mouth before God; from clay I also have been formed.

7.w: Behold, my terror should not frighten you; and my hand on you shall not be heavy.

8.w: Surely you have spoken in my ears, and the sound of the words I have heard.

9.w: ‘I [am] pure, without transgression; I [am] clean, and no iniquity [is] in me.

10.w: Behold, He finds occasions against me; He reckons me as an enemy to Him.

11.w: He puts my feet into the shackles; He watches all my paths.’

12.w: Behold, [in] this you are not right; I will answer you, for God is greater than man.

13.w: Why do you contend against Him, for all words He does not answer?

14.w: For once God speaks, and twice—one does not perceive it.

15.w: In a dream, a vision of the night, in the falling of deep sleep upon men, in slumbers upon a bed,

16.w: then He uncovers the ear of men, and with correction He seals [them],

17.w: to turn aside a man from his doing, and to conceal pride from a man.

18.w: He holds back his soul from the Pit, and his life from crossing over by a weapon.

19.w: And he is churried with pain on his bed, and strife in his bones is continual,

20.w: and his life abhors bread, and his soul food of desire.

21.w: His flesh is consumed from sight, and his bones [that] were not seen are laid bare.

22.w: And his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to those causing death.

23.w: If there is a messenger for him, a mediator, one among a thousand, to declare to man his uprightness,

24.w: and shows him favor and says, ‘Spare him from going down [into] the Pit; I have found a ransom,’

25.w: [then] his flesh is refreshed like a child’s, [and] he returns to the days of his youth.

26.w: He prays to God, and He shows him favor; and he sees His face with a shout of joy, and He restores to the man His righteousness.

27.w: Then he shall sing before men and say, ‘I have sinned, and have twisted uprightness, and He did not requite [it] of me.

28.w: He has ransomed my soul from going down to the Pit, and my life shall look on the light.’

29.w: Behold, all these [things] God does two or three [times] with a man,

30.w: to bring back his soul from the Pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.

31.w: Pay attention, O Job; listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.

32.w: If there are words, answer me; speak, for I delight to prove you right.

33.w: If not, [then] you must listen to me; keep silent, and I will teach you wisdom.”
